summary.text: Gavin Bell is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Lisa Barnes (R) and James Gailliard (D) are also running.
He was previously the Libertarian candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 30 in 2020, District 2 in 2022 and District 7 in 2024.
